qualification.work: Common accounts, MAINLINE040/048/052 and thermal settlement 053
qualification.carry_forward: Reproduced mass accounts and explicit treatment of thermal, cure, edge and scarf conventions. They expose how little favorable reserve remains.
qualification.unsupported: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).

qualification.carry_forward: Strong numerical reproduction of the stated fixed-hull weather and dew calculations. Family optimization, fixed hulls and frozen-thermal gas sampling are now distinguished.
qualification.unsupported: Available weather points are not operational availability. The later 058 day fractions omit exclusions and do not prove a feasible continuous history with admitted air, ballast and ground recovery. [050 addendum](unpublished-local-ref:8c4246c7c11b0da7), [058 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:264dd9e889181247).

qualification.work: MAINLINE057 growth account; MAINLINE060 carbon screen
qualification.carry_forward: Evaluated concept-growth cases remain negative; the corrected 060 compression/reliability accounting retains carbon-frame deficits in its fixed family. These are useful screening results.
qualification.unsupported: Neither is a global impossibility proof. The corrected hypothetical TRL7 row is not achieved maturity; rejected carbon cases do not qualify SiC. [CHECK057](unpublished-local-ref:68eae3652d6c0a12), [CHECK060](unpublished-local-ref:d8968524247a969e).

qualification.carry_forward: 047 addresses the earlier local ellipticity defect; 056 improves agreement with a published simulation under its chosen history and material model.
qualification.unsupported: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).

qualification.carry_forward: Reproduced accounts expose the small reserve and the sensitivity to retention, heat and hardware. The favorable seven-day 054 case leaves only 1.1155 kg.
qualification.unsupported: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).

qualification.carry_forward: A concrete route to discriminating evidence, with independently identified corrections.
qualification.unsupported: Rig gamma must use its own material basis; article/tooling dimensions conflict, statistics are not established, and the $0.42–1.558 million range has no supplier quotes. It is a proposal, not a qualified transfer or procurement basis. [CHECK055](unpublished-local-ref:470b34fc11e934a3).
